questions.answer: Joe's FAQ says SEO is a long-term investment, but timelines depend on your starting point, competition, and goals. Technical fixes and quick wins can show impact within weeks, meaningful organic traffic growth usually appears between three and six months, and substantial compounding results are often visible at six to twelve months [1]. Visibility in AI systems can shift faster, since those platforms update their knowledge bases [1]. For details on working with Joe, see the [contact page](/contact/).
